input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: The IP package meets our preferred position. §14.1 confirms Customer owns all Customer Data, Confidential Information and independently developed IP, with no transfer to Vendor beyond a limited processing right (reinforced by §15.1's no-sale/no-model-training limits). §14.2 vests ownership of Deliverables in Customer with a present assignment from Vendor plus personnel assignments and further-assurances. §14.3 leaves Vendor only its pre-existing Vendor Technology, which is covered by the §13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify, create derivative works and have contractors support it for Customer's business. §14.4 excludes joint ownership absent a signed instrument and keeps feedback use anonymised while preserving Customer's unrestricted rights. No assignment of Customer IP or data to Vendor appears anywhere in the document. The only minor points — Deliverable ownership being conditioned on payment of Fees and the §13.2 licence not expressly saying "sublicense" (though it permits contractor support and derivative works) — are sub-elements short of ideal wording and are noted rather than redlined.
